scope: Attention-only rank-8 LoRA smoke on random 49-frame native subwindows
summary: Dropping adapter rank to 8 did not stabilize the late-backward FSDP all-gather because allocator fragmentation, not adapter capacity, remained dominant: 358 MiB was reserved but unused when a contiguous 200 MiB block failed.
evidence: The run injected 21,233,664 Q/K/V/output LoRA parameters, one quarter of the original attention rank-32 count.
Late backward failed on the same 200 MiB FSDP all-gather while PyTorch reported 358.29 MiB reserved but unallocated.
No checkpoint was written and result.json records PARTIAL.
lessons: Further adapter-rank reduction is not the correct lever for this failure and would unnecessarily reduce adaptation capacity.
PyTorch documents max_split_size_mb as a last-resort native-allocator mitigation for borderline OOMs with large inactive split blocks; preserve rank 16 and apply that allocator setting.
limitations: No optimizer step completed and rank-8 has no quality evidence.
next_actions: Use the native allocator with expandable segments and max_split_size_mb=128, then rerun rank-16/49-frame smoke.
